## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      4 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 10 июл. 2026 г. - 10 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _AJey Calloway_, 18 июл. 2026 г., 1/5: "I'm completely over this app. I joined planet fitness 2 weeks ago and still have not been able to get this app to work. I tried logging in half a dozen times and it freezes. I've only been able to successfully login 1 time and even then it never gave to QR code so that I can scan everytime I enter planet fitness. I'm sooo over this and it's just frustrating. Even the team members that work there couldn't figure out why this is happening."
            2. _Zachary Bohannon_, 13 июл. 2026 г., 1/5: "awful designed app i literally cannot log in to the app it's so broken"
            3. _Emily Foster_, 10 июл. 2026 г., 1/5: "horrible service requires close to 100 bucks just to cancel any membership and workers are rude. Even after you pay the membership they take another payment for what the "last month" would be even if you don't go anymore. there cleaner and nicer places to go for free with kind workers than this place app can also lag a lot and not work for up to 20-25 min never again"
<!--/ir-theme-->
